# Carcavelos Forecast – 15 October 2026

**Small but clean: a mellow day for the books.**

Early morning is your money time. From 04:54 until around 09:00, expect consistent 1.7m waves with light northerly winds keeping things organised. The swell's holding at a solid 10-second interval—proper shape for a dawn patrol session. By 10:00, the wind goes light and variable, giving you a brief glassy window before the sea breeze kicks in around lunchtime.

Afternoon deteriorates gradually. Wind swings SE to SW after 11:00, picking up to 8km/h by 16:00. Waves fade from 1.6m to 1.5m and the period softens. It'll get choppy by mid-afternoon.

**Three tips:** (1) Dawn patrol or nothing—get in before 09:00. (2) Take a shortboard; conditions are small and best surfed with quick equipment. (3) Crowds will be light in the early morning; stick around for the post-work session at your own peril.
